hypothesis.H0: Reserve protection does not explain the night loss; loss equally present in S-L and SW-L
hypothesis.H1: Renewable credit degrades reliability across the day regardless of protection (SW-L fails proportional, S-L passes, wind contrast negative)
hypothesis.H2: Loss arises from removing stored-energy protection at low sun (SW-L passes proportional gate)

control_b.role: safety and fuel reference; re-executed on 2025

notation.e_k: solar elevation at horizon step k, pvlib 0.16.1, Etc/GMT-1, not corrected

equations.E_SW: (1/eta) * sum_k max(0, c_k - s_k - w_k) * dt
equations.E_SL: (1/eta) * sum_k max(0, c_k - (1 - L_k) * s_k) * dt
equations.E_SWL: (1/eta) * sum_k max(0, c_k - (1 - L_k) * (s_k + w_k)) * dt
equations.horizon_edge: E_stage2[23] = max(E_arm[23], E_term), E_term = 100000 Wh (all arms)
structural_properties: L_k = 0 everywhere => E_SL = E_S and E_SWL = E_SW
E_SW <= E_SWL <= E_B and E_S <= E_SL <= E_B pointwise
per-hour replacement, no additive or max(EBR, R) combination
